name: 单 Worker、Lease、Heartbeat 与 Fencing

implemented: checksum-protected one-way migration v2 for attempts, leases, attempt_artifacts, and run_events
global concurrency-one Step claim ordered by Run and Step ordinal
lease heartbeat with monotonic UTC timestamps and bounded expiry
expired lease takeover with a new Attempt and globally monotonic fencing token
fencing checks for heartbeat, Step success/failure, Artifact registration, and Delivery publication
single-worker facade carrying worker identity and lease duration
deferred: real subprocess kill and restart fault injection
unknown Provider outcome handling, cancel, and resume
structured Error records and optional Trace
network, Provider, paid service, and live acceptance

acceptance_results.criterion: concurrent claims across multiple queued Runs create one globally active lease
a later Step is not claimable until prior Step completion
heartbeat extends the current lease and rejects timestamp regression
lease expiry creates a new Attempt with a larger fencing token
old Attempt heartbeat, Artifact registration, Step completion, and Delivery publication are rejected
current Attempt output lineage and final Delivery survive repository reopen

compileall.command: uv run --frozen python -m compileall -q src tests scripts

execution_boundary.fixtures: deterministic in-process Workers with temporary SQLite and filesystem
execution_boundary.claim: W3.2 proves the bounded single-process lease ownership and fencing mechanism only; it does not prove workflow checkpoint recovery or live research execution.
